description: Lead lists from hiring signals: which companies are hiring fastest, or cutting? Ranks companies by job postings added and removed in the last 7, 14 or 30 days, from our recorded history of about 20,000 public job boards crawled twice a day; filter by job function (sales, engineering, data...). Up to 50 companies with company domain when known, ATS and careers page, open roles, added, removed, net change, growth rate and layoff or hiring-freeze signals. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

direction.description: growing ranks by most postings added net; shrinking by most removed net (default growing)

function.description: Rank by one job function's net change, read from job titles (e.g. sales)

minOpen.description: Smallest company to include: open postings at the window's start, 5-5000 (default 10)

staffing.description: Staffing agencies' boards: exclude (default), include, or only
